**Build passes now.** 0 errors, exit code 0.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump:

- [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`, since the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Added an `undefined` case that returns `false`.

The rest of the noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, circular-import, unused-export, etc) is just deprecation chatter, not build-breaking.

Next: nothing.
